important_fixes: Preserve support and placed text of protected partial block entities inside/outside selection
Validate live configurable world border at capture/start and during execution; preserve received safety facts beyond it

reviewed_screenshot.shows: Actual Area Clear settings, corner controls, defaults and safety preferences; not a pause menu

limits: Conservative safe-route refusal is possible; no guarantee of survival or globally optimal excavation.
Fluids, unstable or unknown selected cells reject planning; containers and protected/unreachable leftovers do not count as completion.
High latency, arbitrary server plugins/anticheats, rendering replacements and long-session endurance are not established.
Java restricted multiplayer tools retain current-server view+movement+assistance grants.
Public downloads, Modrinth and final launcher Build/Play are verified separately after publication.
